original.file: result.json in the compare artifact of run 37109532421

trimming.runs: Every field of every run is kept except three lists: notes (52 log-parser notes per serial run, kept only as notes_total), missing_ids (replaced by missing_id_set, which names one of the two lists below; the build asserts equality) and mismatches (only the records whose id is not a missing id are kept, as mismatches_not_missing; every missing id's record has an empty arm side).

decision_rule.eligibility: every run of the arm is eligible under both oracle parts (part 1: zero mismatches against S outside flaky ids, the exact preregistered command, run_attempt 1 recorded in runtime.json; part 2: an existing, empty git-status.txt), at least 3 runs, and its controls and crash control passed on that OS (their run directories under the same two parts)
decision_rule.speed: take the fastest eligible arm by median step_seconds; adopt it only if its median <= 0.6 x S median and its max <= 0.75 x S fastest, compared as exact ratios (rounded for display only); otherwise reject (no fall-through to a slower arm)
decision_rule.unpooled_preference: if the adopted arm is P3 (L4), take P3F (L4F) when it is eligible, meets the speed rule and its median is <= 1.1 x the pooled median (exact ratio)
decision_rule.id_mapping: the inventories differ only by the prefix 'tests.test_native_maintenance.' on exactly the 29 base ids of the six B1 classes, as a bijection; otherwise every OS gets no verdict
decision_rule.every_os: every OS of the preregistration is listed in verdicts; one without any run directory gets no verdict (reason: no run directory)

class_level.rule: every module_level id whose module and class prefix is one of these classes
